ns2:course.label: Bio Psych Lab
ns2:course.description: (PSYCH 311) For students doing research in biological, behavioral and cognitive neuroscience. This course will provide in-depth background knowledge for their research, and teach students to make effective oral and written presentations of their findings. The course may be taken for two terms with the first term emphasizing a review of the literature and the second term concentrating on the presentation of the results. Same as NEUR 411. May be repeated to a maximum of 7 hours. Prerequisite: Students must arrange to do a research project with a faculty member.
